Overview of Escape Road 3
Developer & Release: Developed by AZ Games, the game was released in mid-2026 as the next evolution of the Escape Road series. 
Escape Road 3
 +2
Core Gameplay: You play a getaway driver evading an intense police pursuit across dynamic, multi-terrain environments like city streets, suburbs, deserts, and oceans. 
apps.microsoft.com
 +2
New Mechanics: Unlike earlier titles limited strictly to driving or basic foot movement, version 3 lets you switch vehicles mid-run (cars, boats, planes, gliders, and jet skis) and swim. 
Escape Road 3
 +2
Features & Collectibles: Unlock over 30 characters, Mythic Cars (such as F1 cars, zombie trucks, and alien ships), upgradeable items, and combat mechanics including a handgun dropped by cops. 
Mini-Games: Includes side challenges like F1 racing, firefighting, zombie battles, treasure hunting, and alien invasions.

Controls
Movement: A / S / D or Arrow Keys
Enter / Exit Vehicle: Spacebar
Pause: Tab
Powerups: F
Aim Handgun: Right Mouse Click
Shoot Handgun: Left Mouse Click
